verificationLog.what: Short code character count vs ASIN format
verificationLog.method: Programmatic count of the supplied codes; comparison against resolved product IDs
verificationLog.result: All five supplied codes are 9 characters. All five resolved product IDs are 10 characters. link.amazon codes are therefore opaque short codes, not ASINs, and must not be read as ASINs.
verificationLog.evidence: FLG-002. This is why intendedAsin is a separate, reviewer-supplied field.

verificationLog.result: Amazon states: 'our software automatically adds "-20" to the end of all Store IDs' and gives the example 'amazon-20'. The supplied ID shopnow047c-20 matches the documented US format.

verificationLog.what: Whether shopnow047c-20 is actually enrolled and whether it appears in the observed redirects
verificationLog.method: No access to Associates Central; redirect targets inspected for a tag parameter
verificationLog.result: NOT VERIFIED and NOT OBSERVED. None of the resolved destination URLs observed carried a visible tag= parameter. Enrollment cannot be checked from outside Associates Central.
PA-API 5 is deprecated. Calls receive HTTP 403 AccessDeniedException. Replacement is the Creators API. Prerequisite: Associates enrollment plus at least 10 qualifying sales in the past 30 days.
'You must clearly and prominently state the following... "As an Amazon Associate I earn from qualifying purchases."' A violation of Section 5 is a material breach.

verificationLog.what: Whether prices/ratings may be displayed on the site
verificationLog.result: Prices and availability may be shown only if Amazon serves the link containing that data, or the data comes via Creators API / PA API under the License. Star ratings and customer reviews may only be used if obtained through Creators API / PA API (Section 3(t)).

verificationLog.what: Link integrity rules relevant to redirects and shorteners
verificationLog.method: Associates Program Participation Requirements, Sections 3(v) and 3(w)
verificationLog.result: Associates may not cloak, hide, spoof or obscure the URL containing Special Links, including by use of Redirecting Links (3(v)), and may not use a link shortening service in a way that makes it unclear the link goes to an Amazon Site (3(w)).

verificationLog.what: Disclosure timing standard under US federal guidance
verificationLog.method: FTC Disclosures 101 for Social Media Influencers
verificationLog.result: Disclosures must be hard to miss, placed with the endorsement itself, and are likely to be missed if they appear only on an about page, at the end of posts, or anywhere requiring a click.

verificationLog.method: Google Search Central sitemap documentation and Search Essentials
verificationLog.result: NOT GUARANTEED. Google states that meeting requirements does not mean Google will crawl, index or serve the content. A sitemap is a discovery aid, not a ranking or indexing guarantee.

irregularities.title: One supplied link resolves inconsistently
irregularities.detail: link.amazon/B0c8moW59 returned the ThermoMaven thermometer product page on the first fetch and the Amazon homepage on a second, separate fetch. Because the destination is not stable, no buyer-facing button points at this product, and its card carries a 'link under review' state.
irregularities.action: Re-generate the link in SiteStripe while signed in to the Associates account and record the resulting URL in intendedAsin and officialListingUrl.

irregularities.title: Supplied short codes are not ASINs
irregularities.detail: All five supplied link.amazon codes are 9 characters. Amazon ASINs are 10 characters. Read as ASINs they are malformed, so they are treated as opaque short codes throughout. The 10-character product IDs they resolved to are recorded in a separate observed field, never merged with the intended-ASIN field.
irregularities.action: None required for the site. This is why intendedAsin and observedAsin are separate columns in the register.

irregularities.title: Compliance status of link.amazon short links is unresolved
irregularities.detail: Whether these exact short links satisfy the Special Link formatting and no-cloaking rules cannot be determined without (a) inspecting them while signed in to the Associates account and (b) confirming the tag is present in the redirect. Neither was possible here. This was explicitly flagged as unresolved in the brief and remains unresolved. No claim is made that the links are invalid.
irregularities.action: Test one link per product inside the enrolled Associates workflow. Confirm destination and that the click appears in the tracking report before scaling to the other four.

irregularities.title: No tracking tag was observed in any resolved destination
irregularities.detail: None of the destination URLs observed during verification carried a visible tag= parameter. The Store ID shopnow047c-20 matches the documented US format (S-05), but whether it is attached to these links, and whether the account is enrolled, cannot be checked from outside Associates Central.
irregularities.action: Confirm enrollment and confirm the click appears in the Associates tracking report. Until then the site must not imply that a click on this site earns a commission.

irregularities.title: Product identity is observed, not confirmed
irregularities.detail: Product names, form factors and capacities on this site come from the product pages the short links resolved to. They are strong evidence but they are not a confirmation record signed off by the account holder. The confirmation-date and source fields are therefore deliberately empty.
irregularities.action: For each product, record the intended ASIN, the official listing URL, the confirmation date and the source as four separate values.

irregularities.title: Automated fetching triggered a bot checkpoint
irregularities.detail: The first attempt to resolve link.amazon/B00hJ57DV returned Amazon's 'Continue shopping' checkpoint instead of a product page. A second attempt succeeded. This is a property of automated fetching, not evidence that the link is broken, and it is recorded so the verification method stays honest.
irregularities.action: None. Manual browser verification is the better method for these links.

irregularities.title: Certification and safety claims are unverified manufacturer claims
irregularities.detail: Product pages include manufacturer-stated certifications such as ETL and UL listings and stated accuracy figures. These are the brand's claims, not independently tested results. The site does not repeat them as verified facts and does not repeat them as endorsement.
irregularities.action: Either omit these claims from buyer-facing copy or attribute them plainly to the manufacturer.

irregularities.title: No product has been physically tested
irregularities.detail: The editorial desk has not handled, cooked with, or measured any of these appliances. Any first-person experience language would violate FTC guidance against describing experience with a product you have not tried.
irregularities.action: Keep all copy in second-person, spec-based language until a test protocol and at least one physical unit exist. This constraint is applied throughout the site.

irregularities.title: Product images are not cleared for use
irregularities.detail: No product imagery is used on this site. The brand assets on this build are drawn, not photographed, and product cards intentionally use typography instead of photography. Amazon product imagery may only be used through Program Content under the IP License.
irregularities.action: Either obtain images through the Creators API under the License, or keep the typographic treatment.

irregularities.title: Prices observed during verification are not published to buyers
irregularities.detail: Prices were observed while checking the links. They are held in this register as internal editorial context and are deliberately not shown on any buyer-facing page, because Amazon's rules restrict showing price and availability (Participation Requirements 2(b)).
irregularities.action: Show price to buyers only if Amazon serves the link that contains it, or once Creators API access is in place and the data is presented under the License.

irregularities.title: The research automation has no data source yet
irregularities.detail: Creators API access requires Associates enrollment plus at least 10 qualifying sales in the past 30 days (S-03). With no verified sales history, the product-research pipeline cannot be switched on. Any screen describing automated trend detection is a specification, not a working feature.
irregularities.action: Keep the ledger empty and clearly labelled until sales history exists. Do not present simulated data.

irregularities.title: No analytics provider and no email provider are connected
irregularities.detail: The five defined events are wired into the page, but there is no server endpoint to receive them and no email provider to accept an address. The capture form is therefore visibly disabled rather than silently discarding submissions.
irregularities.action: Deploy a collector endpoint, then set analyticsEndpoint in assets/js/config.js. Connect an email provider before enabling the form.
irregularities.evidence: Not applicable. This is a statement of current configuration.

irregularities.title: Hosting constraint limits a custom domain and a server-side collector
irregularities.detail: GitHub Pages serves static files only. A self-hosted analytics endpoint and a server-rendered redirect handler cannot run on it. Both require separate hosting or a scheduled worker.
irregularities.action: Decide between a static build with an external collector, or moving to a host that runs server code.

irregularities.title: Base path is repository-scoped
irregularities.detail: The site is published under /Affil2 because it is a project Pages site. Every internal link is generated from a single basePath setting so the site can move to a user site or a custom domain without editing pages by hand.
irregularities.action: Change basePath in content/data.json and rebuild.

irregularities.title: AI-assisted drafting is disclosed, not hidden
irregularities.detail: Copy on this site was drafted with an AI assistant from verified source material and a supplied product list. Amazon requires original content with significant commentary and analysis, and FTC guidance prohibits fabricated experience. The site therefore discloses the drafting method rather than presenting a fictional human byline.
irregularities.action: If a named human editor takes over, update the byline and this flag together.

irregularities.title: Search Console is not connected, so performance is unknown
irregularities.detail: There is no verified property, no submitted sitemap and no query data. Statements about discoverability are statements about what the build is designed to allow, not measurements.
irregularities.action: Verify the property, submit the sitemap, then publish a dated first report.
